thread:
jane_sales: Prospect (FinGrid) asks for SOC2 Type II redacted, ISO27001 cert, and a brief pen-test attestation for their procurement checklist. Need by Monday. Also asked if this changes POC pricing. tagging @mike_se @tara_security @nina_legal

mike_se: POC is on hosted sandbox; sharing redacted artifacts shouldn't affect POC pricing. If they want dedicated hosts or extra entitlements we'll quote separately.

tara_security: We can provide a redacted SOC2 attestation page, ISO27001 certificate, and one-page pen-test attestation (scope + date). We do NOT provide raw findings without NDA + internal approval. ETA: 48 hours to assemble.

nina_legal: Confirmed. I'll drop our standard NDA and a short permitted-use clause. If they insist on full pen-test report we'll require a signed NDA and a request form.

jane_sales: They also asked for a one-liner for procurement: "no change to POC fees for evidence sharing"  can someone confirm exact wording to paste?

mike_se: Use: "Sharing redacted compliance artifacts for vendor evaluation will not change the quoted POC fees; any changes to hosting or support entitlements may be quoted separately."

tara_security: Plan: upload package to secure bucket with files: SOC2-Redacted-2024.pdf, ISO27001-Cert.pdf, PenTest-Attestation-Tara-signed.pdf, POC-Dataflow-Sanitized.pdf, Evidence-Cover-Note.pdf. Will share link once NDA outcome known.
